label: sparse conjunction: after a "v v" pair early in the input (plus weak first-copy-step firing)
explanation: Very sparse (0.04% of steps) and weak (median 0.12). Strongest activations, near max, are on the original-phase token right after a repeated "v v" early in the sequence (t=3-5), especially when the sequence starts with r/f/d/s/j/t; activation is roughly 0.5 of max on the step after that. Half the activation mass has prev_tok=v, and about a quarter falls on the first copy step (recall_idx=1, input = orig(0), mostly when the first token is r/f/d). Neither cue is selective: prev_tok=v has precision under 1%, and "v v" in the original phase has precision 0.22 and recall 0.23. Many activations have no v nearby (e.g. after h h h, or digits mid-sequence). Almost never fires at t=0-1 or late (t>=10). No simple predicate gets close to F1 0.8.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
